<thought>The spectrum shows a strong M+2 peak at ~33 % of the base peak, which matches the characteristic 3:1 (≈75 % : 25 %) isotopic pattern of chlorine (35Cl/37Cl). No ~1:1 M+2 pattern (bromine) or a very small (~4 %) M+2 (sulfur) is present. Therefore chlorine is the only element that can be definitively identified from the isotope distribution.</thought>
<final_answer>['Cl']</final_answer>
